statements.text: FRESVIK PRODUKT AS is a limited company with organisation number 922582270, founded on 1978-02-11.
The company engages in producing prefabricated insulation panels, other industrial production, and participating in other business agencies and trade.
Espen Skjerven Holen serves as the chief executive officer and Trygve Simlenes acts as the board chair.
From the period of 2023-12-31 to 2025-12-31, the company's revenue decreased from 77,951,787 NOK down to 66,726,366 NOK.
During the same period from 2023-12-31 to 2025-12-31, operating results decreased from 4,714,009 NOK to 758,412 NOK.
The company's website reports that they have implemented a robot and a chaotic storage system for elements after the summer of 2023.
